info.title: Alza Trade API
info.description:
List of changes from previous version:

  • BREAKING CHANGE: Changed response data structure of unshipped orders endpoint
  • Added new languages and listings endpoints
  • Added new GET order endpoint returning paged collection of orders

For more information about API follow this link

Total endpoint count: 9

Get a collection of parameters.
The resulting collection can be filtered by category.
If no category query filter is used, the operation may take some time.
If the operation takes too long, a timeout status code is returned.

Get category templates (parameters and SEO prefixes) for product listing by given identifiers (the category identifiers are required).
Not found categories will be excluded from returned collection.

get.summary: Get a paged collection of orders.

parameters.name: createdFrom
parameters.description: The order created time to filter from

parameters.name: createdTo
parameters.description: The order created time to filter to

parameters.name: shipmentDepartureTimeFrom
parameters.description: The shipment departure time to filter from

parameters.name: shipmentDepartureTimeTo
parameters.description: The shipment departure time to filter to

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
The order state Note: state 1 (LabelNotGenerated) and 2 (Unshipped) return all orders that also contain states 7 (Delayed) and 8 (DelayedRepeatedly).

Options:

  • 0 = Pending
  • 1 = LabelNotGenerated
  • 2 = UnShipped
  • 3 = Shipped
  • 4 = Canceled
  • 5 = CanceledAfterShipping
  • 6 = Delivered
  • 7 = Delayed
  • 8 = DelayedRepeatedly
  • 9 = ShippedLate
  • 10 = CanceledLate
  • 11 = DeliveredLate
  • 12 = AwaitingCopayAmount
  • 13 = AwaitingPreparation

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of items on page (max 500)

parameters.name: sortDesc
parameters.description: The flag indicating whether items are sorted descending

parameters.name: sortKey
parameters.description:
The sort key

Options:

  • 0 = Id
  • 1 = Created
  • 2 = State
  • 3 = ShipmentDepartureTime
